title: Expie Totem
description: Add expie as a Totem to the minecraft! (ResourcePack)
body:
Hi, do you like **expie**? Now you can add him to the minecraft as a **Totem of Undying**!

He can save your life from minecraft pvp or from creeper or even from fall damage. 

This is resourcepack made by NotTerra. Only Totem of Undying is changed nothing else!

![RESOURCEPACK](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80633d7f33d7f5020509a906c0dd372fac8cc983.png)

Have fun with expie.
